The aqueous line is the one the wastewater
redefinition moved, and it is 95% of the
tonnage: it can gain 71% in one cycle and lose
60% in the next, which is not a quantity
anyone is measuring. The solid line never went
through that change and never moves more than
a quarter between cycles — 4.2M tons in 2001
falling steadily to 2.2M. That is a series you
Sludge is left off deliberately. In 2007 one
handler, Eastman Kodak, is 81% of all
inorganic sludge in the country, and 79% in
2009; by 2011 it is gone. A national line

Almost none of the liquid is recovered — it is treated or put underground. Recovery is a solids and sludge business: metals recovery takes 30%
of inorganic solids and 42% of inorganic sludges, and none of the aqueous liquid. So nothing true of the 95% is true of the 3% where the
Phase is read from form_code, which is exactly one per record and cannot inflate. Tonnage is managed_tons on both record types, all twelve
management categories, 2023 unless a year is given.
